title: Two-qubit-gate operation in a high-connectivity transmon lattice utilizing a tunable coupling to a shared mode
summary: Increasing connectivity and decreasing qubit-state delocalization without compromising the speed and accuracy of elementary gate operations are topical challenges in the development of large-scale superconducting quantum computers. In this theoretical work, we study a special honeycomb qubit lattice where each qubit inside a unit cell is coupled to every other one via two dedicated tunable couplers and a common central element.
